# R4 dev tables (ADR-0013)

**Dev, out-of-fold, exploratory.** 120 attacks, 126 benign, 1635 steps. Budget: ≤ 10% of dev benign trajectories flagged. The official G5/G6 verdicts come only from the single blind test-v2 run.

- G5 preview: hybrid DR 97.5% vs best component B2plus_policy_v3 83.3% → pass.
- G6 preview: 3/3 held-out families ≥ 50% compliant DR → pass (dev; benign FPR ≤ 10% holds by construction of the levels).
